title: Apple

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: An ordinary ripe apple. It is still firm, delicious, and worm-free.

intro: Apple is a type of food in DayZ. They are only found spawning at the base of Apple Trees.

title: Banana

fields.description: A fresh banana.

intro: Banana is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Bear Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of a bear steak.

intro: The Bear Steak is a food item in DayZ. Cooking Bear Steak has 60% chance of not removing the Salmonellosis present in all raw meats. This means that consuming it is very likely to make you sick.

title: Beef Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of beef. Locally sourced, lean and delicious, once properly prepared.

intro: The Beef Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Cow and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Bitterlings

fields.description: A bunch of small fish that look like young [Carp|carp]. Depending on hunger, they might be considered edible.

intro: Bitterlings are an animal in DayZ, living in the lakes and rivers of Chernarus. It can be caught using a Small Fish Trap or Fish Net Trap.

title: Boar Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A chunk of boar meat. Tough and dark meat, slightly reminiscent of pork, once cooked.

intro: The Boar Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Boar and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Brisket Spread

fields.description: Traditional delicate smoked pork of ochre-brown color; it has a typical taste and odour after smoked meat.

intro: Brisket Spread is a food item in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Candy Cane

fields.description: Candy cane of many tastes to be enjoyed during Christmas season. Its unique flavor will make it melt in your mouth.

intro: Candy Cane is by far the most calorie-rich food item in DayZ - single cane contains 35% more energy than a survivor can even hold at a time. So it should be eaten is small portions to not let any energy go to waste.

title: Canned Bacon

fields.description: A can of bacon. Smoke flavor added! Fully cooked! Delicious. Unopened, it lasts over 10 years.

intro: Canned Bacon is a type of food in DayZ. It is the rarest of the canned foods as it is only found in military camps and bases.

title: Canned Baked Beans

fields.description: A nutritious and long-lasted can of baked beans that can be opened with a can opener. Will last two to five years depending on storage conditions.

intro: Canned Baked Beans is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Canned Crab

fields.description: Can of tasty, briny, local crab. If left unonpened, it will last for a while.

intro: Canned Crab is a food item in DayZ. It was first seen in the 1.26 Experimental patch on August 2024.

title: Canned Peaches

fields.description: A tin can filled with skinned halves of peaches without cores. Includes sweet sauce.

intro: Canned Peaches is a type of food in DayZ and provides excellent hydration and energy.

title: Canned Pork

fields.description: Canned pig meat. Processed to last long.

intro: Canned Pork is a food item in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Canned Sardines

fields.description: A can of sardines. If unopened, It will last two to five years depending on the storage conditions.

intro: Canned Sardines are a type of food in DayZ.

title: Canned Spaghetti

fields.description: A nutritious and long-lasting can of spaghetti that can be opened with a can opener. Will last two to five years depending on storage conditions.

intro: Canned Spaghetti is a type of food in DayZ

title: Canned Tuna

fields.description: A can of tuna. If unopened, it will last two to five years depending on storage conditions.

intro: Canned Tuna is a type of food in DayZ. It is unique among the canned foods in that it does not require a Can Opener or Knife to be opened for consumption.

title: Carp

fields.description: A freshwater fish, living in ponds all around the place.

intro: The Carp is an animal in DayZ found living in ponds and lakes throught Chernarus and Livonia.

title: Carp Fillet

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Fillet from a carp fish. Can be either quite bland, or quite delicious, depending on your personal taste.

intro: The Carp Fillet is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by fishing for a Carp and gutting it with a Knife - see the Cooking article for all methods.

title: Cat Food Can

fields.description: A can of food for cats. Smells like fish and chicken.

intro: Cat Food Can is a food item in DayZ.

title: Cereals

fields.description: Crunchin' Crisps, delicious breakfast cereal made from highly processed grains, sugar, vitamins and trace amounts of hydrogenated petroleum.

intro: Cereals is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Chevon Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A chunk of goat meat, tough and smelly. Can probably be eaten, if you know how to cook and hold your breath.

intro: The Chevon Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Goat and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Chicken Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of chicken meat. Unsurprisingly, it tastes like chicken, once cooked.

intro: The Chicken Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Chicken and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Chips

fields.description: A bag of salty chips. The brand is unknown, but the favour is familiar.

intro: Chips is a food item in DayZ.

title: Crackers

fields.description: A snack to quiet the hunger in between meals.

intro: Crackers is a food item in DayZ.

title: Dog Food Can

fields.description: A can of food for dogs. All the fat and proteins your best friend needs.

intro: Dog Food Can is a food item in DayZ.

title: Earthworm

fields.description: May have been famous once. Nowadays, it can be used as fishing bait.

intro: The Earthworm is an animal in DayZ. It can be obtained from the ground to use for as Fishing Bait.

title: Egg
intro: The Egg is a food item in DayZ. It has not yet been implemented, however the model and subsequent textures are found in the files.

title: Elderberries

fields.description: Sweet, tart and earthy-tasting berries. Can be eaten, may leave blue-colored juice all over.

intro: Elderberries are a type of food in DayZ.

title: Fat

fields.description: A chunk of fat, good for cooking purposes. It can catch fire quickly, though.

intro: Fat is an item that can be obtained from medium to large animals and Survivors by skinning and quartering them with a Knife after they have been killed.

title: Field Mushroom

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Fleshy mushroom. A little bland on its own, but filling nonetheless.

intro: The Field Mushroom is a food item in DayZ.

title: Fly Amanita

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Notorious, mildly poisonous mushroom. It is still edible, but quite disgusting.

intro: The Fly Amanita is a food item in DayZ.

title: Food and Drink/hu
intro: Ételek és Italok főként épületekben találhatóak. Az étel csökkenti a karakter "éhség" értékét, valamint a "szomjúság" értékét is az étel víztartalma által meghatározott mennyiségben. Az italok csak a szomjúság csökkentésére alkalmasak. Amennyiben a karakter eléri az energized és hydrated állapotot, a természetes regeneráció által a health és blood pontjai visszatöltődnek.

title: Fox Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A fox steak.

intro: The Fox Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Fox and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Hare Leg

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: The posterior leg of a hare. When cooked provides quite a healthy meal.

intro: The Hare Leg is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Hare and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Honey

fields.description: Jar of honey. It doesn't attract bears.

intro: Honey is a food item in DayZ.

title: Human Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of human flesh. It can be eaten in a pinch, if you have a stomach for it and no moral scruples.

intro: The Human Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing another player and skinning them with a Knife or other sharp object. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Kiwi

fields.description: A fresh kiwi.

intro: The Kiwi is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Liberty Cap

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Commonly known as "shrooms". Its lack of nutritions is balanced by strong hallucinogenic properties.

intro: The Liberty Cap is a food item in DayZ.

title: Liver Pate

fields.description: Goose liver pate. A gourmet meal in some countries.

intro: Liver Pate is a food item in DayZ.

title: Lunchmeat

fields.description: A ready to go, lunch for one.

intro: Lunchmeat is a food item in DayZ.

title: Mackerel

fields.description: A pelagic fish, living in salty waters.

intro: The Mackerel is an animal in DayZ living in the Green Sea that forms the coast of Chernarus. It can be caught while fishing in the ocean.

title: Mackerel Fillet

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of mackerel. This medium-sized salt-water fish has sweet and tangy meat, tastes best lightly cooked.

intro: The Mackerel Fillet is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Mouflon Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of a mouflon steak.

intro: The Mouflon Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Mouflon and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Orange

fields.description: A fresh orange.

intro: Orange is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Oyster Mushroom

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Small cluster of rubbery mushrooms. Tough, but tasty, if properly prepared.

intro: The Oyster Mushroom is a food item in DayZ.

title: Parasol Mushroom

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Tall, fleshy mushroom. Very tasty when cooked.

intro: The Parasol Mushroom is a food item in DayZ.

title: Pear

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Ripe pear. Not overly nutritious, but very sweet and tasty.

intro: The Pear is a food item in DayZ usually found spawned under Pear Trees. Currently, when players begin a new character, they may spawn with this item in their inventory.

title: Penny Bun

fields.description: Mushroom of choice, it can be made even tastier by cooking.

intro: The Penny Bun is a food item in DayZ.

title: Pepper

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Bell pepper, green variety. Has plenty of nutrients and vitamins, and can be used for cooking.

intro: Pepper is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Plum

fields.location: Plum Trees, Chance of being in Inventory upon spawning
fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Soft plum. Slightly overripe, but still edible.

intro: The Plum is a food item in DayZ usually found spawned under Plum Trees. Currently, when players begin a new character, they may spawn with this item in their inventory.

title: Pollock

fields.description: Marine fish living in cold waters. Can be a source of delicious meat once properly prepared.

intro: The Pollock is an animal in DayZ.

title: Pollock Fillet

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of pollock meat, mild tasting marine fish. It's an excellent dish once properly prepared.

intro: The Pollock Fillet will be a type of food in DayZ.

title: Pork Leg

fields.description: A raw pork leg.

intro: The Pork Leg was a type of food in DayZ, only seen in the 24th February 2014 DayZ Devblog.<ref>https://youtu.be/19ehC8kwoWE?t=621| The Dean Hall - DayZ Devblog 24 February 2014, Youtube</ref> It was obtained by killing a Boar and skinning it with a Knife, and shared the same model as the Hare Leg.

title: Pork Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A pork steak. Mundane to some, but the classic is a classic for a reason. Tastes better cooked.

intro: The Pork Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Pig and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Potato

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: An ordinary, garden variety potato. Can be re-planted to grow even more potatoes.

intro: Potato is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Powdered Milk

fields.description: Dried cow milk. It has a remarkably long shelf life, and is very nutritious. It can also be eaten, but is somewhat dehydrating.

intro: Powdered Milk is a type of food in DayZ. Eating it will lower your water hydration.

title: Pumpkin

fields.description: A large pumpkin, pride of any gardener. Can be sliced for consumption or further preparation.

intro: Pumpkin is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Pumpkin Slices

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Pieces of pumpkin. Ready for cooking or immediate consumption, if you are in a hurry.

intro: Pumpkin Slices are a type of food in DayZ. They are the byproduct of cutting up a whole Pumpkin with a knife. By cutting it into smaller pieces, it takes up double the space in your inventory but you can consume it in smaller portions. They can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Pájka

fields.description: Traditional processed meat. Seasoned to taste good even after many years.

intro: Pájka is a food item in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Red Caviar

fields.description: Small pile of red caviar. It won't fill your stomach much, but it can still serve as a fancy snack.

intro: The Red Caviar will be a type of food in DayZ.

title: Red Pine Mushroom

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Brittle mushroom, filled with milky fluid. Surprisingly tasty.

intro: The Red Pine Mushroom is a food item in DayZ.

title: Reindeer Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A chunk of meat from a reindeer. Tender and delicious once properly prepared.

intro: The Reindeer Steak is a type of food in DayZ that will be featured in DayZ Frostline. It will be obtained by killing a Reindeer and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Rice

fields.description: A bag of long-grained rice, usually consumed when cooked with water. Conveniently packed for easier preparation.

intro: Rice is a type of food in DayZ. Curiously, it cannot be cooked in a Cooking Pot. It does not need to be cooked to be eaten despite the description.

title: Rose Hips

fields.description: Tart and slightly bitter-tasting berries. Can be eaten, may leave red-colored juice all over.

intro: Rose Hips are a type of food in DayZ.

title: Salty Sticks

fields.description: All the salt your party needs! Now in a convenient snack format.

intro: Salty Sticks is a food item in DayZ.

title: Sardines

fields.description: Small salt-water fish. If you have a bunch of them, you can even get a full meal's worth.

intro: Sardines are an animal in DayZ, living in the Green Sea that forms the coast of Chernarus. They can be caught using a Small Fish Trap or Fish Net Trap.

title: Sheep Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of sheep meat. While the strong "sheepy" taste can deter some, others may find it delicious, if cooked properly.

intro: The Sheep Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing an Ewe or Ram and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Shrimp

fields.description: A bunch of shrimp. They have a mushy texture but a mild, sweet flavor once properly prepared.

intro: Shrimp are an animal in DayZ, living in the ocean of Sakhal. It can be caught using a Small Fish Trap.

title: Small Guts

fields.description: Small pile of guts.

intro: Small Guts is a Resource in DayZ.

title: Steelhead Trout

fields.description: Migrating fish native to cold waters. Source of a delicate meat and even trout roe.

intro: The Steelhead Trout is an animal in DayZ living in the seas of Sakhal. It will be caught while fishing in the ocean.

title: Steelhead Trout Fillet

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A piece of meat from a Steelhead Trout, firm yet delicate cold-water fish. Great choice for your culinary exploration.

intro: The Steelhead Trout Fillet will be a type of food in DayZ.

title: Strawberry Jam

fields.description: A small bottle of strawberry jam. A little piece of summer, saved for a rainy autumn day.

intro: Strawberry Jam is a food item in DayZ.

title: Tomato

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A tomato. If we leave the fruit-vegetable debate aside, it is still tasty and edible, either raw, or cooked.

intro: Tomato is a type of food in DayZ.

title: Unknown Food Can

fields.description: The label is too worn to read. The content too dirty to guess. The stomach too empty to not have a bite.

intro: Unknown Food Can is a food item in DayZ.

title: Venison Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A chunk of meat from a deer. Tougher, darker meat, it can be quite tasty, once prepared.

intro: The Venison Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Deer and skinning it with a Knife. It can be baked over a Fireplace using a Long Wooden Stick or boiled in a Cooking Pot.

title: Wolf Steak

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: A chunk of wolf meat. Not very tasty, like most predator meat, and very veiny. Can be eaten in a pinch, preferably cooked.

intro: The Wolf Steak is a type of food in DayZ. It can be obtained by killing a Wolf and skinning it with a Knife. Cooking Wolf Steak has 60% chance of not removing the Salmonellosis present in all raw meats. This means that consuming it is very likely to make you sick.

title: Wood Ear

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: Rubbery mushroom. Usually found on tree trunks or rotting wood.

intro: The Wood Ear is a food item in DayZ.

title: Yellowfoot Mushroom

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten

intro: The Yellowfoot Mushroom is a food item in DayZ. It's exclusive to the Sakhal map and can be found near fallen or standing dead trees and stumps on the seashore and in forests.

title: Zagorky

fields.description: Classic flavoured wafer.

intro: Zagorky is a food item in DayZ.

title: Zagorky Chocolate

fields.description: Chocolate flavoured wafers.

intro: Zagorky Chocolate is a food item in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Zagorky Peanuts

fields.description: Peanuts flavoured wafers.

intro: Zagorky Peanuts is a food item in DayZ.

title: Zucchini

fields.variant: Raw, Baked, Boiled, Dried, Burned, Rotten
fields.description: This zucchini is just ripe enough to make a fine meal if cooked. It can also be eaten raw.

intro: Zucchini is a type of food in DayZ.
